profile.reading:
This facility sits at 900 Guardians Way, Allen, Texas 75013, roughly 20 miles north of downtown Dallas. Its OSM record and building name, "Evoque Allen DA1," retain the legacy branding of Evoque Data Center Solutions, the AT&T-divested data center business Brookfield formed in 2019 and later combined with Cyxtera to create the Centersquare brand in April 2024, since renamed Csquare; Csquare's own current Dallas-Fort Worth market page names this facility "DFW2," alongside Fort Worth (DFW1) and a third unnamed site (DFW3), and "DA1" does not appear anywhere on Csquare's current site or SEC filings, consistent with this building carrying over its pre-rebrand Evoque-era code in third-party and mapping data even after Csquare's current naming convention changed. Csquare went public via IPO on NASDAQ in July 2026 at $21.00 per share. Csquare's own spec page states 43,366 square feet of raised floor at DFW2, closely matching its SEC Form S-1 property table figure of 44,215 square feet for "Dallas-DFW2_A," 53.7 percent leased and Csquare-owned as of March 31, 2026. Csquare states 8.6 megawatts of utility power for this site, with SOC 1/2 Type II, PCI-DSS, NIST 800-53 PE High, and ISO 27001 compliance certifications. Csquare does not name a power utility or year-opened date, and no reference to a Texas-specific data center tax incentive was found in Csquare's own materials for this site.

Allen sits in Collin County, part of the northern Dallas-Fort Worth suburban technology corridor that has drawn substantial corporate and data center investment over the past two decades. Csquare's SEC S-1 discloses 389 megawatts of total sellable power capacity across its full 64-facility, 21-market portfolio as of March 31, 2026, and the filing's Exhibit 2.1 confirms the October 31, 2023 asset purchase agreement between Cyxtera Technologies and Phoenix Data Center Holdings LLC, the Brookfield-affiliated acquisition vehicle behind the January 2024 deal that brought this and other former Cyxtera sites into what became the Centersquare, and later Csquare, portfolio.

sources.title: Csquare, Inc. Form S-1 Registration Statement, Exhibit 2.1 Cyxtera Asset Purchase Agreement

Evoque Allen DA1 is a facility in Allen, Texas, operated by Centersquare. The operator has not published a power capacity figure for this campus. Without a published specification, its size relative to other AI infrastructure cannot be determined from operator claims.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 publish power capacity totaling 468 MW. This campus does not appear in the ranked list of published capacity, placing it outside the top 18 in the state. Whether it hosts AI infrastructure depends on specifications the operator has not disclosed.

The campus exists as a verified physical location. Determining whether it matters to AI scaling requires published power capacity, power quality certifications, and cooling specifications that are not on record.
